urces References Table of Contents Solana Documentation References Clusters and Public RPC Endpoints Copy Markdown Open The Solana blockchain has several different groups of validators, known as Clusters. Each serving different purposes within the overall ecosystem and containing dedicated API nodes to fulfill JSON-RPC requests for their respective Cluster. The individual nodes within a Cluster are owned and operated by third parties, with a public endpoint available for each.
